lightload.configuration.title: %s Configuration
lightload.configuration.section.resource: Resource indexing, caching, and reload execution settings.
Optimizations applied while Minecraft is starting.
Master switch for Lightload startup optimizations.
lightload.configuration.general.profilin: Collect and log startup optimization statistics.
lightload.configuration.general.showLoad: Show the completed startup time above the version branding on the title screen.
lightload.configuration.general.aggressi: Enable optimizations with larger startup-time impact. Recovery mode disables these after an interrupted launch.
lightload.configuration.general.optimiza: Profile selection: auto, lightload_full, or conservative.
lightload.configuration.resources.memory: Keep resource lookup indexes in memory.
lightload.configuration.resources.persis: Persist compatible resource indexes between launches.
lightload.configuration.resources.cacheR: Cache whether resources exist in individual packs.
lightload.configuration.resources.maxExi: Disable the disk existence index when it exceeds this size.
lightload.configuration.resources.cacheR: Cache the contents of small resources in memory and on disk.
lightload.configuration.resources.maxCac: Resources larger than this value are not cached by content.
lightload.configuration.resources.parall: Search safe groups of resource packs in parallel.
Minimum number of safe packs required before parallel lookup is used.
lightload.configuration.resources.dedica: Use dedicated worker threads for resource reloads.
lightload.configuration.resources.reload: Number of resource reload threads. Zero selects a value automatically.
lightload.configuration.resources.isolat: Prevent selected optional mod reload listeners from aborting the entire reload.
Comma-separated listener class patterns. An asterisk matches all optional mod listeners.
lightload.configuration.startup.lazyData: Requested lazy DataFixer initialization. This optimization is unavailable on Minecraft 1.21.1 and remains safely disabled.
lightload.configuration.startup.progress: Warm model-related caches progressively during startup.
lightload.configuration.startup.fastText: Use Lightload's faster texture-atlas packing path when compatible.
lightload.configuration.startup.lazyBloc: Defer expensive block-state cache construction until it is needed.
lightload.configuration.startup.deferRem: Delay nonessential remote configuration and supporter downloads until startup completes.
lightload.configuration.startup.deferYac: Delay optional YACL image loading until startup completes.
lightload.configuration.startup.forgeReg: Cache repeated NeoForge registry existence lookups.
lightload.configuration.startup.mixinTar: Allow the optional Java agent to index Mixin configurations by target class.
lightload.configuration.startup.voxelSha: Reuse equivalent voxel shapes created during startup.
lightload.configuration.compatibility.co: Use conservative resource behavior when Connector is present.
lightload.configuration.compatibility.li: Enable the dedicated compatibility path when Lightspeed and ModernFix are installed together.
lightload.configuration.compatibility.oc: Allow the optional agent to optimize Oculus resource-path callbacks.
lightload.configuration.agent.earlyAgent: Enable compatible transformations when Lightload is launched as a Java agent.
lightload.configuration.agent.parallelJa: Reserved for a future NeoForge-compatible Jar-in-Jar implementation; currently disabled by default.
lightload.configuration.agent.jarJarThre: Worker count reserved for Jar-in-Jar metadata processing.
lightload.configuration.agent.runtimeTra: Allow supported runtime bytecode optimizations such as Access Transformer indexing.
